---
title: "World Flags"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

# Get all flag codes from the data directory
flag_files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.png$")
codes <- sub("\\.png$", "", flag_files)

# Look up country names for the codes
countries <- tibble(
  code = codes,
  name = countrycode(toupper(codes), origin = "iso2c", destination = "country.name")
) |>
  mutate(name = if_else(is.na(name), toupper(code), name)) |>
  arrange(name)

# Pass data to Observable JS
ojs_define(flag_data = countries)
```

```{ojs}
// Dropdown input to select a country
viewof selected = Inputs.select(
  flag_data.code,
  {
    label: "Country",
    format: code => {
      const idx = flag_data.code.indexOf(code);
      return flag_data.name[idx];
    },
    value: "eg"
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
// Display the selected flag image
html`
<div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
  <img 
    src="data/${selected}.png" 
    alt="Flag" 
    style="max-width: 400px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);"
  />
</div>
`
```
